CT073-3-2-CSLLT Computer System Low Level Techniques - Individual Assignment (60% of the module). Level 2.
NOTE: the official brief was not supplied. The requirements below are reconstructed from the submission's cover page and structure:

tasks.text: Develop a program in x86 assembly language (NASM) that demonstrates arithmetic operations (ADD and SUB), loops, and conditional and unconditional jumps, with input validation.
Research and critically analyse why assembly language is still relevant, where it is used, and its role in cyber security, digital forensics and malware analysis.
Document the system design (functions, flowcharts, data design), implementation, testing, a user manual and screenshots.
Use APA referencing. Students must obtain 50% overall to pass.
